main.description: Records a funding receipt for a payment from one user to another user. It may be recorded by the recipient, by the sender, or by a third party. The sender may remain anonymous.

from.description: The sender of the funds (a free-text string, an account DID, or a strong reference to a record). Optional — omit to represent anonymity.

to.description: The recipient of the funds (a free-text string, an account DID, or a strong reference to a record).

amount.description: Amount of funding received as a numeric string (e.g. '1000.50').

currency.description: Currency of the payment (e.g. EUR, USD, ETH).

paymentType.description: Asset class of the payment: 'crypto' for payments settled in cryptocurrency, 'fiat' for payments in government-issued currency. This is the explicit crypto-vs-fiat discriminator — consumers should classify by this field and treat receipts without it (or with an unrecognized value) as unclassified rather than assuming fiat. Orthogonal to paymentRail: a card-funded crypto purchase is paymentType 'crypto' with paymentRail 'credit_card'. Note the amount/currency pair cannot substitute for this field: receipts often record a normalized fiat-equivalent amount (e.g. USD) for crypto payments, and stablecoin payments carry fiat-pegged currencies. knownValues is an open, advisory vocabulary.

paymentRail.description: Mechanism by which the funds moved. knownValues is an open, advisory vocabulary — other values are permitted. The rail alone does not determine the asset class (a crypto purchase can settle via 'credit_card'); use paymentType for the crypto-vs-fiat distinction. For 'onchain' payments, set paymentNetwork to the chain and transactionId to the transaction hash.

paymentNetwork.description: Optional network within the payment rail: the blockchain for 'onchain' payments (e.g. ethereum, arbitrum, celo) or the processor/scheme for fiat rails (e.g. stripe, paypal, sepa, visa). Strongly recommended for 'onchain' payments — a transaction hash is not interpretable without knowing its chain.

transactionId.description: Identifier of the underlying payment transaction (e.g. bank reference, onchain transaction hash, or processor-specific ID). Use paymentNetwork to specify the network where applicable.

for.description: Optional strong reference to the activity, project, or organization this funding relates to.

notes.description: Optional notes or additional context for this funding receipt.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this receipt record was created.

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.

text.description: A free-text string value (e.g. a display name, wallet address, or other identifier).
